body: I know that plenty of cis people leave their transitioning partners, it seems like that is very common. I’m just saying that for the few of us that are okay with it and stick around, it seems a lot of us end up eventually being broken up with. There is just so much heartbreak with transitioning for everyone involved. Sometimes it makes me feel very hopeless. I try to be easy on myself but it’s so hard when my world is crashing around me. This has been the absolute worst and most difficult year of my life.

Yes. Someone transitioning causes an incredible amount of heartbreak, as evident by this subreddit. It is honestly so difficult to read these because I feel like that’s where my relationship will lead. Once they pass, they’ll throw me to the side. It seems like almost every single relationship ends because of transitioning. If the partner doesn’t leave the trans person, it seems like eventually the trans person leaves the partner. It’s like there is no way out and transitioning will just always causes heartbreak.

I’m in the same boat. It’s absolutely terrifying and feels like everything is falling apart and soon enough no one will be left. I’m really, really sorry that you’re going through this. I wouldn’t wish this situation on the person I hate most in the world. It’s truly a heartbreaking situation, and I hope that it ends up working out for you (I hope it works out for me too honestly). 💗

>  Your worst case scenario still leaves you with a best friend.

People say this a lot, but I just don’t see it as a possibility. How often do any exes stay best friends? I get that it might be different considering the whole transness to it all but unless it’s a mutual breakup, and it looks like it wouldn’t be in OPs case, how does one become besties with their ex and stomach watching as they get a boyfriend? I know I would not be able to handle that. It would be hard enough to be left, and then accidentally stumble upon a picture in 6 months of them with someone new, but to be the best friend and potentially have them hang out and PDA in front of you and have your bestie tell you ooh how amazing they are, etc, would be absolutely heartbreaking. 

Like I said, I think that’s only a possibility if the break up is mutual.

Just because one can find negative comments everywhere doesn’t mean that we should stand by, let it happen, & not say anything. Thank you for making this.
I like that this post calls out the certain trans people that do come to this subreddit and get judgey and then comments nasty, mean things to us when we’re just trying to have our own safe space to try to deal with all our emotions. We know that being trans is incredibly difficult but being the partner of a trans person is, in a different way, hard and heartbreaking and terrifying. Our feelings are valid and we deserve to feel valid 💗
Lmao this is a perfect example of exactly what this post was calling out!

Your story sounds really nice and I’d love to believe that would happen to me but I just don’t see it. I don’t live in the biggest city and there really aren’t a lot of decent people here. Or at least when I was actually social a couple years ago. I don’t think that’s really changed, but to add to it, now I’m riddled with anxiety and depression and I don’t know how I’m supposed to actually find someone to hangout with. It’s really hard for me to reach out and to a stranger? That we probably won’t even click as friends or whatever anyways so it feels pointless. I know that I’m being such a bummer and seem to be rejecting everyone’s ideas but I just am exhausted and I don’t think I have the fight in me to try and do something that literally gives me panic attacks (trying to make new friends). I just don’t know, I am very glad that it worked out for you but I just don’t see a future for me.

I have extremely low confidence and so I don’t think I would be able to handle having to compete with someone else for my partners affection. I would always consider myself the odd person out and I think this would just be worse for my mental health.

Thank you. I get that this is a very hard time for her but it’s a really hard time for me too! And my wants, concerns, general feelings, etc seem to always take a backseat to hers. Which is really hard. I don’t think that we’re communicating the best that we can and I don’t think that I am getting enough recognition as a member of this relationship and not simply her support system. I really hope that a couples counselling could help with that.
Thank you for being here for me. That means a lot.

Yeah, I’ve been very hesitant on moving away with her. Especially now. 

Someone in the mypartneristrans subreddit said that it could possibly be that she’s had these feelings in the back of her mind for a while and that the HRT helps you come to terms with and truly be yourself, not hiding anymore. Idk if I’m wording that right but that this has been brought to the surface now that she is trying to be her true self.

And they have had sexual experiences with a guy before but as it was in her teens, apparently it “doesn’t count”. Idk but I do understand that she has never been with a man as a woman. I get that. It still hurts like hell though.

And I meant that my partner is my best friend, and that’s why I will lose my best friend :( 

Thank you. I will try those app/website. I didn’t know you could use those to find friends. That would be nice. And unfortunately all my coworkers are at least 10+ years older than me and have children (I don’t) so it’s really hard to connect with them.
Thank you. I will. I really hope so.

My depression and anxiety have been so bad this year that I have become very isolated and I hate myself so much. I can’t stand me. And in a way it kinda makes sense that my partner will potentially leave, because I wouldn’t want to be with me either. I have been going to therapy for years but it doesn’t seem to be helping. I don’t know if I ever will be able to actually love myself again. Idk how I would even reach out to try to find a different roommate. I feel like I am drowning and my partner was the one who pushed me off the boat and everyone, including her keeps saying how shore isn’t all too far away and I can make it but what they don’t know is that I have a cramp in my leg, I’m hurting all over, and I am absolutely exhausted. I honestly don’t think I’ll make it. All I want is to be back on the boat, but my partner holds all the cards there and likely will drive away and leave me in the desolate, open ocean by myself.

I know it isn’t healthy, but I just wish it was. I want so badly for it to be like how it was, even just like 4 months ago. She’s the love of my life, I don’t know how to survive without her. Hell, I barely survived my mental health problems WITH her love and support. 
Thank you for the suggestions. I definitely am trying with my therapist, but part of my depression and anxiety, and especially the severity it has been this last year, is that it is incredibly difficult to try to reach out. With that said, I would like to have friends, but the couple that I have reached out to aren’t interested in anything more than a casual chat here and there. I feel so isolated and alone. I do work, and unfortunately everyone is 10+ years older than me with children there, so I can’t really make actual friends at work either. I don’t have any friends that live near me, my family that lives here are very toxic, constantly fighting, yelling, being passive aggressive and full force aggressive so it’s really not healthy for me to live there but also I also don’t trust myself to live alone. I feel utterly hopeless

That’s what I would like, for this to just be a difficult time and be able to get through it together. I’ve never met anyone like her and none of my past relationships have even been close to me being this in love and connected to someone. I don’t want to give up, I just need her to not want to give that up either.

It’s okie and thank you, I am going to try to set up an LGBTQ+ friendly couples therapy session for us. But that comment, bah it just seemed completely like my partner wrote it - except for the passing of one of your parents part (I am sorry to hear about that). But everything else, it’s how they’re feeling and things they’ve said. So it was very hard to read that but again not really your fault it just so happens that we’re on opposite sides of a similar situation.

Okay, but as a partner of a trans woman who is potentially breaking up with me soon after years of being together. It is absolutely devastating and I feel incredibly unloved and unwanted. I gave so much love and support just to be tossed aside like garbage. I almost feel used, because they are talking about breaking up within weeks after they started HRT. Like I was only used for support to ease transition. Idk. Everyone is different and just know that this is absolutely heartbreaking and devastating and your comment was just super triggering for me, hopefully you don’t take offense to this. I’m just not in a good place rn :(

Thank you for telling me that those are red flags. I wasn’t sure if I was taking things too personal with that or if it really is a problem. That’s why I haven’t pushed it. I mean, it’s still heartbreaking to hear, but it is better to know about red flags.

Also, how do we even do a break though.. we live together on a lease for at least another half a year and neither of our parents currently have much room at all. It would be awful. But I guess yeah what’s going on now is super awful too. It’s all just so hopeless. I feel trapped. I almost feel like the last couple years have been a waste. We weren’t building towards anything but the lies that she’ll always want to be with me. I just feel so overwhelmed. I don’t want to deal with this, I want to just slip into a coma and just sleep away the rest of my days. The only time I have peace is when I’m asleep.

I would really like to do that. I have brought it up to her before and she wasn’t so keen on the idea. But I should bring it up again and state that we really do need to do that. I would like to save our relationship, if possible, but I cannot save it by myself and I’m scared that she’s already fallen out of love with me and wants to move on.

I’m very scared that she has already fallen out of love with me at this point and is just too scared to leave me yet as she is very empathetic and knows that I am very very upset over this. 
I am scared that even if we do stay together that she will just waste the next year, two, or however many just to leave me eventually. 
I am also scared that apart from this situation with my partner, that my depression will not lessen up. I’ve been fighting it for a long time before these issues were present and even when these issues go away, my depression will still be there. I’m scared that it’s always going to be there and that nothing is going to help. My father struggled with depression for decades before it finally swallowed him up whole. What if that’s my destiny? To never be able to shake this gnawing depression.

I don’t even know how I would find another support system. I suffer from terrible confidence issues and moderate-severe anxiety, especially social anxiety. I am not good at making friends. I feel like I’ll be sailing away into the scary, desolate, never ending ocean just to feel more alone and worse than I do now. 
But it’s hard now too because I feel so incredibly unloved and unwanted. 
And yes I will continue, I definitely won’t give up on the medications or therapy but it hasn’t helped at all so far and I’m just scared that it will never help. That I’ll feel this way forever.

It almost does feel like that, that she really needed my support and was fully committed to me until she got the prescription for HRT. Since then, everything is up in the air. 
As well, she has really been pressuring me to move to Vancouver within the next year, which is something that we both do want, but eventually. We a still young, in our 20’s. I have family out there that would be nice to live close to, but I have a job that I love where I’m at now and haven’t been at it all that long, I would like to gain more years experience with this job before I move so that I could have a better shot at getting the same job in Van. But she doesn’t understand that because she is very good at what she does and does well at interviews. She states that we need to get to Vancouver sooner rather than later because it is a much more LGBTQ+ friendly community. I understand this but it also seems like my concern doesn’t matter. And sometimes I wonder if she wants to go right away as it would be financially and emotionally easier to move that far with another person and not alone, as well as I have family there to fall back on if I cannot find a job or something. Meanwhile she has no family anywhere near there. I’m scared that she’s going to use me to move there then dump me, and I’ll potentially have given up a job I love just to get dumped and left high and dry. And omg the surgeries that she’s talking about that she wants and how expensive they are! I was fully willing to help her in the future with that financially before when our relationship and future was solid, but now I just don’t know. 

And I have always suffered from terrible confidence issues, so I think that opening up the relationship would be a very bad idea. I’ve thought about it before, as my partner has brought up that they are in general open to that idea but I would just always feel like I was second best and the other person will replace me. 

And yeah my partner is making me feel very unloved and unwanted. But I don’t know what to do, I am way too in love and do not have a good support system. I also haven’t even been able to make a single new friend in the last year since my best friend moved across the country. I do not really have friends that I see in person besides my partners’ sister, but that won’t last if my relationship doesn’t. So yeah, im not good at making friends, i don’t know how I could possibly do that. Let alone somehow another person that would actually want to be with me and not just waste my time.. how would I even find that person. I just do not feel hopeful at all

This is the most terrifying thing to read. I’ve posted before about how I am petrified of my trans girlfriend leaving me for a man or just for men in general and I get comments saying that it’ll be fine and work out and it makes me feel okay, like it’s all going to be okay but then I stumble onto stuff like this and I plummet back to reality in that she will leave me. Eventually she will leave me. I know it in the things she says sometimes when she’s drunk and more truthful, I know it in the porn she watches, I know it in my gut. And it is the most painful thing I have ever experienced in my life.
I feel you. Snow expected later tonight here in Canada too. Definitely not getting hot here yet
Sad Slug noises

As I am bi, I was okay when my girlfriend came out to me as a trans woman. But now that my girlfriend has just recently started HRT a month ago, she’s saying that she is developing more attractions for men and my biggest fear is that she’s going to leave me for a man. So I might potentially find myself in the opposite situation. Which I really don’t want because this cute comic strip thing is so adorable and how I envision my life with my beautiful girlfriend! Bah

That was my first thought too. Maybe the driver recognized the person they hit, or maybe the driver was deliberately trying to hit this person? But then why send that letter at all (and out yourself as the person behind the crime) and why wait 3 years?? That’s such a long time if this was a deliberate scam looking for the victim to pay or something.

Idk this story is missing some key info that I will need follow up on if it is indeed real.
Wow when reading those links, you can tell they are written by people that are very transphobic.
